# Ugenix Academy

> Ugenix Academy is a professional online training academy focused on prompt engineering and technology skills. We help learners build job-ready, portfolio-backed skills with industry practitioners who teach from real projects.

## About

Ugenix Academy offers courses in:
- Prompt engineering (crafting effective prompts for AI systems, understanding AI behavior)
- Technology skills taught through real-world thinking and applied projects

Courses are designed and taught by practitioners who actively work with the technologies they teach. Content reflects current industry practices.
